text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
T-Trainer-san!
Thank you so much for letting me observe on such short notice!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: I'll compile everything I saw into a report... and make the next event even better... Alright!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: I'll give it my all too, so I can stand tall and be proud of my work.
